question: Should OpenClaw adopt this PR's baseline-backed boundary-safety validator with its 224-entry legacy inventory as a required full and changed-file check now?
rationale: The code is reviewable, but the required guard and baseline/noise profile change maintainer workflow and future CI behavior, which automation cannot safely accept on its own.

options.title: Adopt The Guard Now
options.body: Accept the 224-entry inventory as the legacy contract and merge after exact-head CI is attributed or green.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Ask for a smaller branch that keeps the guard, baseline, and guard tests while dropping runtime overlap already covered by merged focused fixes.

options.title: Pause Broad Enforcement
options.body: Keep landing focused boundary fixes separately and pause or close this broad check-gate proposal until maintainers want repository-wide enforcement.

recommendation.title: Adopt The Guard Now
recommendation.body: Accept the 224-entry inventory as the legacy contract and merge after exact-head CI is attributed or green.
